Family dinner
Aug 2026 • Family
We had dinner at Cardinal inside The Reverie with a total of 12 guests. Ten adults selected the set menu, while the two children ordered separate dishes.
Initially, I had hoped that the eight family members who live in Ho Chi Minh City and joined us could order à la carte. However, the waiter encouraged us to consider the set menu, and my husband ultimately agreed. In retrospect, I would have appreciated more time to review the menu and its contents in detail before making that decision, as I may have chosen differently.
My daughter, sister-in-law, and I do not eat foie gras, so that course was not suitable for us. Had I known in advance that foie gras was included in the set menu, I might have preferred ordering à la carte so that everyone could select dishes they would enjoy.
The restaurant itself is very beautiful, and I appreciated the opportunity to gather with our family for dinner. My only disappointment was that the set menu was not the most suitable option for everyone in our group. I hope that in the future, the restaurant waiter will give guests more time to review the menu and make their own choice rather than placing too much emphasis on the set menu.

Compliments to the chef and his kitchen team
Mar 2024 • Friends
Have been aiming to visit Cafe Cardinal for Sunday brunch for some time. Finally made it and was not disappointed. The food was delicious with plenty of options to chose from the buffet as well from a small a la carte menu. The restaurant had a 3-piece band playing nice background music that added to the overall atmosphere but was not so loud we had to raise our voices to chat. At 888k VND per person, this is probably one of the best priced Sunday brunches in HCMC. In my opinion, the price represented excellent value for money for the quality of the food and the number of options. In fact, I was surprised the restaurant was not busier! A free-flow alcoholic package was also available at a very reasonable price. As I was driving, I opted to drink the fresh fruit juices, which were all included in the 888k buffet price. Kudos to the chef and his team as the food was delicious. Special call out to the lamb, which was served carvery style. I went back for more lamb at least 4 times. I believe they rotate between beef, pork and lamb depending on the Sunday.

Terrible and disgusting management and hospitality
Jan 2022 • Family
We had an afternoon tea here as a family gathering before Tet holiday and the cafe gave us a terrible experience.
We had a table of 12 people at around 2pm and intended to order separately as individual preference. However, the staff kept pushing the tea set for us and told "it's compulsory for everyone to have at least one order". Then we ordered 3 tea sets with like more than 12 different drinks but the staff still said each set is for only 2 people so we need to order a few more drinks to match the regulations. Obviously we refused to do so because we couldn't finish what we have ordered. But the staff kept intervening our conversations and asked us to order more. 
I noticed some staff and probably manager looking at our table and laugh. The staff was so unfriendly and hostile toward us, which it is not how any fine dining restaurant service is.
It is absolutely ridiculous and disgusting how the hospitality in here is. My family had organized a wedding in the hotel, had family meals in this cafe for a lot of times but we never got treated this unbelievable level of unprofessionalism for a high-end dining restaurant.
My family WOULD NEVER come back here again and I hope the management would be fixed before you lose a lot more customers.
Regards,
